name: LONGi Green Energy Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: LONGi Green Energy Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells monocrystalline silicon wafers, solar modules, and green hydrogen equipment in China, Europe, the Asia Pacific, and the United States. The company offers monocrystalline silicon wafers, including tere, p-type, and n-type silicon wafers; high conversion rate components comprising Hi-MO X10, Hi-MO 9, Hi-MO 7, Hi-MO X6 Max, Hi-MO X6, Hi-MO 5m, and Hi-MO 5; green hydrogen production equipment that include ALK Hi1 and ALK G; and building photovoltaics, such as LONGi Hi ROOF S and E, as well as Longji Longding 6 and Longjin 3.
